# Post the Notice

*Clement must cry the Knights' Court's notice to travellers: keep to daylight hours on the World Tree Road. He would like it posted at the wayside well on the Hedge Lanes as well, and the Orange Mushrooms there are no help.*

## Objectives

- Look at the wayside well in [The Hedge Lanes](../maps/hedge_lanes.md)
- Defeat 25 [Orange Mushroom](../monsters/orange_mushroom.md)

- 200 EXP
- 160 mesos
- [Red Potion](../items/red_potion.md) x8
- +10 standing with Selsior
- +80 standing with [Clement](../npcs/clement.md)
